test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

A Gita is considered / to be a dialogue between / the Pandava prince, Arjuna, / and Lord Krishna.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the article "**A**" before "**Gita**."
 
• The sacred text should be referred to with the definite article "**the**" instead of the indefinite article "**a**."
 
• The phrase should correctly read as "**The Gita is considered**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The Gita is considered to be a dialogue between the Pandava prince, Arjuna, and Lord Krishna."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "to be a dialogue between"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "the Pandava prince, Arjuna"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "and Lord Krishna"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
